dialog.minted_coins.menu.title: Minted Coins
dialog.minted_coins.menu.body: Mints are merchants that strike coins from ingots. Coins can only come from a mint, so nobody can counterfeit them.
dialog.minted_coins.menu.new.tooltip: Place a mint 2 blocks in front of you and choose the coins it strikes.
dialog.minted_coins.menu.list.tooltip: Every mint with its position and rates, to teleport to it, edit it or remove it.
dialog.minted_coins.menu.help.tooltip: How mints, coins, names and editing work, and who can use this menu.
dialog.minted_coins.create.title: New mint
dialog.minted_coins.create.body: The mint appears 2 blocks in front of you. An empty name is taken from a renamed item, as explained in Help…, or keeps its default. Set a slider to 0 to leave a coin out.
dialog.minted_coins.create.name: Mint name
dialog.minted_coins.create.confirm.toolt: 9 coins always melt back into 1 ingot. Below 9 per ingot, the mint keeps the difference.
dialog.minted_coins.help.title: Minted Coins help
dialog.minted_coins.help.mint: The mint takes the name typed in the Mint name field. Left empty, it is named after the renamed item in your main hand (a name tag renamed in an anvil, for instance), otherwise "Mint #N".
dialog.minted_coins.help.coins: Coins take the names typed in the coin name fields. Left empty, they are named after a renamed gold, copper or iron nugget, or renamed prismarine crystals, in your inventory (otherwise "Gold Coin", "Copper Coin", "Iron Coin" and "Diamond Coin"). These items are only read, not consumed.
dialog.minted_coins.help.rates: 9 coins always melt back into 1 ingot, and the mint buys back 9 of its own diamond coins for 1 diamond: below 9 coins, the mint keeps the difference.
dialog.minted_coins.help.small: With small change, the mint also changes each coin into 9 small coins, and 9 of its own small coins back into 1 coin.
dialog.minted_coins.help.edit: Edit… on the page of a mint changes its names, rates and small change: the mint is replaced by a new one at the same place, and the coins it already struck stay its own. Coins struck before a renaming keep their old name: the mint exchanges them one for one for coins under the new name.
dialog.minted_coins.help.purse: Each mint sells its purse for 1 leather and 1 string. Put its coins in it like in a bundle, without limit: anything else is handed back. Right-click with it to see what it holds and withdraw coins.
dialog.minted_coins.help.access: Operators open this menu with /function minted_coins:mint/menu, which also lets them open it later with /trigger minted_coins.mint.menu. Creating or editing a mint runs an operator command: Minecraft asks you to confirm it.
dialog.minted_coins.list.title: Mints
dialog.minted_coins.list.body: Choose a mint to see its position and rates, teleport to it, edit it or remove it.
dialog.minted_coins.remove.title: Remove the mint?
dialog.minted_coins.remove.body: Remove the mint %s? Coins it already struck stay valid.
dialog.minted_coins.not_loaded.title: Mint not loaded
dialog.minted_coins.not_loaded.body: %s is not loaded right now. Teleport to it and try again, or forget it if it no longer exists.
dialog.minted_coins.not_loaded.forget.to: Removes the mint from the list without touching the world.
chat.minted_coins.no_coin: Choose at least one coin to strike.
dialog.minted_coins.edit.title: Edit %s
dialog.minted_coins.edit.body: Leave a name empty to keep the current one. Renamed coins: the coins already struck keep their old name, and the mint exchanges them one for one for new ones. Set a slider to 0 to stop striking a coin.
dialog.minted_coins.edit.confirm.tooltip: The mint is replaced by a new one at the same place. A coin set to 0 is no longer struck, changed or bought back by this mint.
chat.minted_coins.not_operator: Only operators can open the Minted Coins menu. An operator opens it once with /function minted_coins:mint/menu; after that, /trigger minted_coins.mint.menu is enough.
chat.minted_coins.revoked: Your access to the Minted Coins menu has been removed.
dialog.minted_coins.purse.title: Purse · %s
dialog.minted_coins.purse.empty: This purse is empty. Put coins of %s in it like in a bundle: they join its contents, without limit.
dialog.minted_coins.purse.withdraw_all.t: Every coin of the chosen kind.
chat.minted_coins.purse.not_held: Hold the purse in your hand to withdraw coins.
chat.minted_coins.purse.rejected: Only coins of %s go in this purse
